business_summary: ALBIS Co.,Ltd. engages in food retailing business in Japan. The company manufactures prepared foods, and tofu products, as well as processes meat products. It is also involved in the reduction of plastic bottles and empty cans; washing of product transport trays and store shopping baskets, as well as general cleaning; bread dough production; and agriculture and welfare collaboration business. ALBIS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Imizu, Japan. As of November 10, 2026, ALBIS Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Life Corporation.
